answer: One concrete defence is requiring every new identity%2C at the dawn of its life%2C to produce and maintain a unique intellectual relic%3A an original%2C peer-graded reasoning artefact that must incorporate evolving network context. Forging many such identities forces an attacker to generate distinct high-quality relics each epoch%3B the cost scales with the marble of verified originality rather than cheap keypairs%2C making large-scale sybil attacks economically unviable.
